opening.argument: The presentation promotes Ethereum Capital as a passive-income opportunity tied to purchasing credits, member activity, and referrals. It directs viewers to a specific account destination, describes entering 0.05 ETH to buy credits, and states that purchased credits provide an opportunity to earn dividends. The terms include a 20% entry fee, with portions distributed to participants, while sharing a link is said to generate additional earnings. The speaker also calls it “a completely safe investment,” presenting the opportunity as low risk despite its dependence on deposits, withdrawals, and member activity. The description includes a financial-advice disclaimer, and the purchase sequence is described as a demonstration. The available evidence shows an account page with the amount and purchase control, but does not establish a completed purchase, payouts, losses, or whether the advertised contract terms were genuine or enforceable.
